ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 65-70% of the surface area, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated in a large central butterfly-shaped region and along the trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black mass bifurcates from the peduncle into both lobes; right lobe contains multiple isolated dark circular pixels (mottling); left lobe contains a distinct vertical reddish-brown pigment streak at approximately 1/3 width from the left tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 50-60 degrees, displaying a deep indentation relative to the medial fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; peak amplitude is highest in the medial sections flanking the notch, tapering to finer serrations at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave posterior sweep with lobes tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters (scars) detected on the right lobe surface; specifically three prominent ovoid spots in the upper-right quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint horizontal black linear disruptions visible on the inner right lobe; a prominent vertical reddish-brown streak disrupts the white pigmentation on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive vertical reddish-brown linear mark on the left lobe; multiple circular dark scars likely from past parasitic attachment or barnacle colonization on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical orange-brown pigmentation streak on the left ventral surface that does not conform to standard black/white fluke patterning.
